1.description: Medium boiler output in pellet mode

3.name: MAX fan output
3.description: Fan output for maximal burner output

4.name: MED fan output
4.description: Fan output for medium burner output

5.name: MIN fan output
5.description: Fan output for minimal burner output

6.name: MAX exhaust fan output
6.description: Exhaust fan output when pellet burner is working on maximal output

7.name: MED exhaust fan output
7.description: Exhaust fan output when pellet burner is working on medium output

8.name: MIN exhaust fan output
8.description: Exhaust fan output when pellet burner is working on minimal output

9.name: Boiler hysteresis
9.description: If the boiler temperature drops below the present boiler temperature by the boiler hysteresis value, then the automatic burner firing up of the burner will take place.

10.name: Feeding cycle time
10.description: Whole feeding cycle time OPERATION.  Cycle time OPERATION=FEEDING TIME OPERATION+FEEDER STANDSTILL TIME.

11.name: Minimal boiler output FL
11.description: Mimimal output at witch the burner can operate in Fuzzy Logic mode (output modulation).

12.name: Maximal boiler output FL
12.description: Maximum output at witch the burner can operate in Fuzzy Logic mode (output modulation).

13.name: Parametr A FuzzyLogic
13.description: Param. related to aut. modul. of boiler output at remote stab. of boiler. Increas. the value acceler. the speed of boiler output increase. Too hogh value causes instab. to maintain pres. boiler temp.

14.name: Parametr B FuzzyLogic
14.description: Param. related to aut. modul. of boiler output at remot. stab. of boiler. Increas. the value acceler. the speed of boiler output increase. Too low value causes instab. to maintain pres. boiler temp.

15.name: Parametr C FuzzyLogic
15.description: Param. related to aut. modul. of boiler output at remote stab. of boiler. It is not recommended to change this parameter.

16.name: Firing-up airflow 1
16.description: Preliminary blowing-up power during firing-up. Too highy value extends the firing-up process or makes failed attempt firing-up.

17.name: FIRE UP exhaust fan output
17.description: Exhaust fan output during FIRE UP mode. High output may cause unsuccessfull atemp for fire up.

18.name: Ignition test time
18.description: Process of checking whether the furnace is already burning. Only the fan is running. If the flame is of sufficient brightness, the machine proceeds to OPERATION mode bypassing the FIRE UP mode.

19.name: Firing-up time
19.description: Time of a signle attempt to fire up. After this time, controller proceeds to another attempt to fire up. After the failure of all attempts to fire up, the alarm: "Failed to fire up" is reported.

20.name: Fuel dose
20.description: Fuel dose during firing up. Concerns first testing firing up. Next tests fuel dose is reduced.

21.name: Heating up time
21.description: Igniter heating up time before activating the fan. It should not be too long in order to not damage the igniter. After this time the igniter works still, until detecting flame.

22.name: Flame detection
22.description: Threshold of flame detection in % of light, when the controller decides that the furnace is already heated. It is also used for detection of fuel shortage.

25.name: Blowing after firing up
25.description: Fan power after successful FIRE UP.

26.name: Exhaust fan output after firing up
26.description: Exhaust fan output after firing up. High output may cause that burner will burn off.

28.name: Supervision time
28.description: Time of maximum stay the regulator in the SUPERVISION. After this time from the moment of passing the controller in to the SUPERVISION burner is automatically burned off. SUPERVISION TIME=0 the mode is completely switched off.

32.name: Exhaust fan output in Supervision
32.description: Exhaust fan output in supervision mode

33.name: Minimum fan output
33.description: Min. airflow output that the user can set. It is used only to reduce the aval. pow. range of the cont. It should be as small as possible but allow the fan to rotate slowly and freely.

34.name: Maximum time of burning off
34.description: After this time there is transition into PAUSE mode, even though flame sensor indicates flame.

35.name: Minimum time of burning off
35.description: Burning off will last at least this time, even though the flame sensor indicates no flame.

36.name: Parameter A Lambda
36.description: Affects the adjustment speed of oxygen value present in exhaust to present oxygen value; it also affects the stability to keep the oxygen in exhaust. It is not recommended to change this value.

37.name: Parameter B Lambda
37.description: Affects the adjustment speed of oxygen value present in exhaust to present oxygen value; it also affects the stability to keep the oxygen in exhaust. It is not recommended to change this value.

38.name: Parameter C Lambda
38.description: Affects the adjustment speed of oxygen value present in exhaust to present oxygen value; it also affects the stability to keep the oxygen in exhaust. It is not recommended to change this value.

39.name: Airflow correction range
39.description: Defines the acceptable airflow range variation during the operation using Lambda sensor.

40.name: MAX Oxygen
40.description: Present oxygen value in exhaust when the burner runs at maximum output.

41.name: MED oxygen
41.description: Present oxygen value in exhaust when the burner runs at medium output.

42.name: MIN oxygen
42.description: Present oxygen value when the burner runs at minimal output.

43.name: Feeder efficiency
43.description: Fuel feeding speed of main feeder in kg/h.

44.name: Fuel calorific
44.description: Fuel caloric value in kWh/kg. For wood pellet about 4,8 - 5,0 kWh/kg.

45.name: Capacity of tank
45.description: Fuel tank capacity until meausuring fuel level. Inputting correct value frees the user from necessity of conducting fuel level calibration. After the fuel level calibration, the controller does not use the FUEL HOPPER CAPACITY parameter.

48.name: Maximum boiler temperature
48.description: Maximum boiler temperature. At first the boiler keeps preset boiler power and then it modulates the output in order to not overheat the boiler above temp set in this parameter.

49.name: Min. Preset boiler temperature
49.description: Min. present boiler temperature that can be set by the user in menu and min. temperature that can be set by the controller, for example, from night time decreases, weather control, etc.

50.name: Max. Preset bolier temperatrure
50.description: Max. present boiler temperature that can be set by the user in menu and max. temperature that can be set by the controller, for example, form weather control, etc.

51.name: HUW preset temperature
51.description: Temperature, to which the HUW tank will be heated. Note: too high temperature may cause scalding from hot tap water!

52.name: Min. HUW preset temp
52.description: It is a parameter which can be used to limit the user's ability to set to low HUW preset temperature.

53.name: Max. HUW preset temperature
53.description: This param. determ. the max. temp. to which the HUW feed. will be heated while discharg. exceed. boiler heat in alarm states. Setting too high value can lead to the risk of scladning from hot water.

54.name: HUW pump mode
54.description: Allows for the select. of oper. mode of HUW. NO PRIORITY - parallel operation of HUW pump and cent. heat. pumps, PRIORITY - only HUW pump operates, SUMMER - prep. only HUW (building heating disabled).

55.name: HUW cont. hysteresis
55.description: This parameter defines after what temperature drop measured by HUW sensor, the HUW pump will be activated (HUW = hot tap water), when compared with HUW preset temperature.

56.name: HUW disinfection
56.description: Once this parameter is enabled every week, on Monday, at 2:00, hot tap water will be heated to 70°C in order to disinfect the HUW tank. Note: risk of scalding form hot water!

57.name: HUW source
57.description: Determines the energy source for the domestic hot water system

58.name: SUMMER mode
58.description: SUMMER mode means deactivation of central heating while leaving HUW heating. Automatic activation of the mode is executed on basis of indications of weather temperature sensor.

59.name: SUMMER mode act. temperature
59.description: External temperature, above which the SUMMER mode will be activated, if the automatic detection of the SUMMER mode is on.

60.name: SUMMER mode deact. temperature
60.description: External temperature, below which the SUMMER mode will be deactivated, if the automatic detection of the SUMMER mode is on.

61.name: Boiler pump start temp (water)
61.description: Param. determines the temp. of water at which the boiler pump will be activated. The temperature for boiler pump activation by flue gas must be also reached.

62.name: Boiler inc. by HUW, Mixer
62.description: Par. det. by how many deg. pres. boiler temp. must be higher to load the HUW feed., buffer, and mix. circuit. Increas. pres. b. temp. is achieved only when pres. b. temp. is low. than other pres temp.

63.name: Extending HUW pump operation time
63.description: Allows for removal of heat from boiler by HUW feed. directly after the HUW feed. is load. In order to cool the boiler, the oper. of HUW pump can be extended by a period of extended oper. of HUW pump.

66.name: Boiler pump start temp (flue gas)
66.description: Param. determines the temp. of flue gas at which the boiler pump will be activated. The temperature for boiler pump activation by boiler temp must be also reached.

67.name: Preset mixer 1 temperature
67.description: Preset temperature for controlled heating circuit when the weather control is ooff. When the weather control is on, the parameter is not included by the controller for the heating circuit of the mixer.

68.name: Preset mixer 2 temperature

69.name: Preset mixer 3 temperature

70.name: Preset mixer 4 temperature

76.name: Max. mixer 2 temp.
76.description: Limits possibility of setting too high a preset mixer temperature by the user and by the controller. For MIXER SERVICE = FLOOR ON determines value of maximum temperature in heating circuit above which mixer pump will be switched off.

112.name: Thermostat select.
112.description: Param. allows for room therm. select. for control. heating circuit. OFF - turns off therm. oper., UNIVERSAL - refers to stand. therm., ecoSTER 1,2,3 - therm. signal is retrieved form ecoSTER panel.

116.name: Circulating pump standstill time
116.description: Determines the intervals between activations of circulating pump. Parameter available after connection of extra C module.

117.name: Circulating pump operation time
117.description: Determines the operating time of circulating pump. Parameter available after connection of extra C module.

119.name: Curve shift
119.description: Allows for correction -  temperature increase/decrease in the controlled heating circuit when the weather control is on and when the heating curve does not match the building characteristics.

120.name: Curve shift

121.description: Allows for correction -  temperature increase/decrease in the controlled heating circuit when the weather control is on and when the heating curve does not match the building characteristics.

122.name: Curve shift

123.name: Room  temp. factor
123.description: Correct. factor for pres. temp. in the heat. circ. based on the read. of room temp. sensor. The higher the value, the higher the temp. correct. in the heat. circuit. ecoSTER room p. must be connected.

124.name: Room  temp. factor
124.description: Correct. factor for pres. temp. in the heat. circ. based on the read. of room temp. sensor. The higher the value, the higher the temp. correct. in the heat. circuit. ecoSTER room p. must be connected.

129.name: Exhaust fan in cleaning
129.description: Exhaust fan in cleaning mode. Recommended setting 100%.

130.name: Burner cleaning
130.description: It is a time of continous operation of burner, after which the burner will be automatically burned off, cleaned, and fired up again.

132.name: Exhaust fan power in burning off
132.description: Exhaust fan power in burning off. Recommended setting 100%.

133.name: Loading start temperature
133.description: Param. defines buffor max. temp., below which the process of buffer loading will start. Process of buffer loading ends, when the buffer min. temp. reaches the temp. of BUFFER LOADING END TEMP. param.

134.name: Loading end temperature
134.description: Param. defines buffer min. temp., above which the process of buffor loading will end. Process of buffer loading starts again, when the buffer max. temp. falls below the BUFFER LOADING START TEMP.

135.name: Alarm level
135.description: Fuel threshold value in which the following warning will be displayed: LOW FUEL LEVEL!

136.name: Fuel shortage detection time
136.description: The time is counted after decrease in brightness of flame below value of "Flame detection". After deducting this time the controller goes into burner firing up , and after 3 failed attempts issues alarm "Failed firing up attempt".

137.name: Operation time of external feeder
137.description: Operation time of additional feeder (external) to fill the silo by the boiler from big silo (bunker)

138.name: Reserve boiler
138.description: Defines the temp. of pellet boiler below which reserve boiler is activated (e.g. gas boiler). Setting to "0" value turnes off control of reserve boiler and switches 46-47 contact to alarm control.

139.name: Fuel type
139.description: This parameter allows  to change the fuel. For a given fuel will be loaded the new settings in the menu:OUTPUT MODULATION.

140.name: Maximum burner temperature
140.description: Determines maximum burner temperature with which exceeding maximum burner temperature alarm will be issued.

142.name: Cleaning time FIRE-UP
142.description: Cleaning time before FIRE UP mode. It allows to get out the residual ashes and unburned pellets from the combustion chamber before FIRE UP.

143.name: Cleaning time BURNING OFF
143.description: Cleaning time burning off. It allows to clean completely the burner combustion chamber from ashes and unburned pellets.

144.name: Blowing time
144.description: Air flushes time during fuel burnout BURNING OFF.

145.name: Blowing pause
145.description: Pause between blowings while burning up fuel in BURNING OFF.

146.name: Blowing start
146.description: Flame brightness by which blowings start while burning up fuel in BURNING OFF.

147.name: Blowing stop
147.description: Flame brightness by which blowings stop by burning up fuel in BURNING OFF.

148.name: Operation with Lambda sensor
148.description: Turns off and on the operation of Lambda sensor.

156.name: Preset boiler output
156.description: Preset boiler output. It can be set from 50% to 150%. The controller always keeps preset boiler output as a first conditions. When the preset boiler output is too high, and boiler temp is near to the Maximum boiler temp, controller automaticaly lower the boiler output.

157.name: Auto embers maintenance
157.description: Turns ON/OFF the mechanism for residual fuel detection. If the function if activated, tehre will always be a layer of hot embers in the boiler.

158.name: Operation extension
158.description: Operation extension when fuel detection mechanism is active and there is low fuel in the boiler.

159.name: Door sensor activation
159.description: Activating door sensor contact. When it is ON, the exhaust fan will start automatically after opening the door handle for FIRE UP or REFILL mode.

160.name: Firing up exhaust fan power
160.description: Exhaust fan power during FIRE UP mode

161.name: Embers maintenance exhaust fan power
161.description: Exhaust fan power during embers layer maintenance

162.name: Fire-up flue gas end temperature
162.description: When this temperature is reached, the controller will switch from FIRE UP to OPERATION mode

163.name: Maintenance time
163.description: For this time, the controller will start the exhaust fan in order to maintain the layer of embers. It will work according to parameters: Air flush time in maintennace, Embers maintenance fan power.

164.name: Max. refill time
164.description: Max. refill time when door sensor is disactivated.

165.name: Fire-up time
165.description: Time after which the controller switch from FIRE UP to OPERATION mode despite the Fire-up flue gas end temperature is not reached.

167.name: Emergency work fan speed
167.description: Exhaust fan power during emergency mode. Emergency mode can be activated when the flue gas temp sensor is damaged. TI is obligatory to be by the boiler during the emergency mode and check the flue gas and water temp.

170.name: Hot embers layer size
170.description: When set 100% for the embers layer size, then the exhaust fan will turn off immediately after low fuel detection from the detection mechanism. When set lower value, the exhaust fan will extend its operation and the ember layer size will be smaller. Operation extension must be ON.

171.name: Minimal OPERATION time
171.description: For this time the fueld detection mechanism is deactivated.

172.name: No fuel flue gas temp
172.description: When the flue gas temperature drops below this value, then the controller will switch OFF the exhaust fan and shows a message: No fuel from flue gas temperature.

173.name: Embers maintenance interval time
173.description: Interval for switch ON the exhaust fan during the embers maintenance mode

174.name: Air flush time in maintenance
174.description: Exhaust fan operation time in embers maintenance mode

175.name: Preview time
175.description: Time of preview to the boiler chamber. When the doors are closed during the preview time, then the operation time counter is not restarted. When the preview time exceed, then controller switch to REFILL mode and restart the counters.

178.name: AHS contact normal open
178.description: If On - AHS contact is normal open\nIf Off AHS contact is normal close

180.name: Heat dissipation temperature
180.description: After exceeding this temperature the mixer and HUW pumps will start in order to cool down the buffer.

181.name: Heat recovery hysteresis start
181.description: These parameters determine the temperature differences between the buffer and boiler, at which the boiler pump will be switched off/on. Parameter Heat recov. stop hyst. = OFF setting, the buffer cooling protection function will be switched off.

182.name: Heat recovery hysteresis stop
182.description: These parameters determine the temperature differences between the buffer and boiler, at which the boiler pump will be switched off/on. Parameter Heat recov. stop hyst. = OFF setting, the buffer cooling protection function will be switched off.

185.name: Flue gas - Max. Boiler Power
185.description: Flue gas temp - Max. Boiler Power

186.name: Flue gas - Min. Boiler Power
186.description: Flue gas temp - Min. Boiler Power

187.name: MIN exhaust fan power
187.description: Minimal exhaust fan power in wood mode.

188.name: MAX exhaust fan power
188.description: Maximal exhaust fan power in wood mode

189.name: Auto pellet burner activation
189.description: Automatic pellet burner activation when the wood combustion ends and the temperature in the buffer if lower then preset value. The burner starts delay time must be also reached to start the pellet burner

190.name: Burner auto activation
190.description: Automatic burner activation when wood burning is finished. The time of delay must be reached to start the pellet burner.

191.name: Start of the burner delay
191.description: You can set a delay for the pellet burner start. It is good to set a delay in order to keep hot embers in the boiler chamber.

193.name: Select fuel type
193.description: Choose what type of fuel are you using now.
